subject: [PATCH 2/2] firmware: arm_sdei_nmi: Send the backtrace IPI to CPUs with SDEI masked

reviews.author: Kiryl (Meta) (author)
reviews.summary: The author acknowledged that the patch needs to handle CPUs with SDEI masked by sending them a regular backtrace IPI, and explained how this is already implemented in the code.

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the SDEI (System Description Event Interface) NMI handler to send a backtrace IPI to CPUs that have SDEI masked, allowing them to be included in the backtrace even if they are in a power-down idle state or going offline. The patch also introduces a new function `arm64_backtrace_ipi` to send the regular backtrace IPI to a given mask of CPUs. This change fixes an issue where such CPUs were reported as not responding after 10 seconds.
